exposure: concurrent depression or anxiety after pregnancy
cohort: 87,807 pregnancies from the Norwegian Mother and Child Cohort study, including 1,842 plural births
finding: While mothers expecting multiple births had normal mental health during pregnancy, an increasing risk for depression was observed up to 5 years after birth.
followup_time: 17th and 30th week of gestation, 0.5, 1.5, 3, and 5 years postpartum
